# `<ds-chat-message>` — `ChatMessageComponent`

Group: Display & feedback

One message of a chat: `role: ChatMessageRole = 'assistant'` puts a filled bubble on the right (`'user'`) or a subtle one on the left (`'assistant'`). `author` shows above the bubble; `time` (already formatted) under it, in a thread only under the last message of a run; `sentAt: Date | string | number | null` lets a thread split runs by time; without `author` the role is spoken (`DS_INTL.chat.user` / `assistant`). Slots: default (the text, or the markdown your app renders; a user message keeps its line breaks), `[steps]` above the bubble, on the thread's surface (a `ds-timeline` of the agent's steps; a message with only steps draws no bubble), `[attachments]` under the text (`ds-chat-attachment` for something to open, `ds-tag` for a plain file), `[actions]` under the bubble (copy, retry), shown on hover or focus and always without hover. Text is selectable and long words and URLs wrap. The window, tabs, composer and question cards around it stay in the app. `streaming` marks a reply still arriving (caret after the text, `aria-busy`, `[actions]` hidden; the thread reads it when it completes). `status: ChatMessageStatus | null` is the delivery of a sent message, under it in place of the time: `'sending'` (dimmed), `'failed'` with a Retry button emitting `(retry)`; `'sent'` shows nothing and is only spoken; the app resends and sets `status` back.
Tokens: `--ds-chat-message-max-width` (default `85%`), `--ds-chat-message-radius`, `--ds-chat-message-padding`, `--ds-chat-message-user-bg-color` / `-user-color`, `--ds-chat-message-assistant-bg-color` / `-assistant-color`.
